title: Binary Search
summary: Repeatedly halves a sorted range to locate a target in O(log n).
usage: Lookup in sorted arrays / monotonic predicates. Requires sorted input.
pythonSource:
def binary_search(a, t):
    lo, hi = 0, len(a)-1
    while lo <= hi:
        mid = (lo+hi)//2
        if a[mid] == t: return mid
        if a[mid] < t: lo = mid+1
        else: hi = mid-1
    return -1
